title: Live shows the next song, not only the next cue, in Cue-by-Cue
acceptance: When the current song's last cue is next, Cue-by-Cue shows the next song's title (for example 'Next song: Rollin''), so 'End of track' is not the only hint.

The next song's title stays in the focal card after the song's last cue, whether the Next row then says 'End of track' or names the first cue of a later song. Mid-song, with more than one cue or move still ahead, and on the class's last song, the focal card is unchanged.
The line is text with a visible label (no meaning by colour alone, no motion), and Live's playback, seeking, transport and screen-reader cue announcements are unchanged.

resolution: Cue-by-Cue's focal card names the song after the live one, as 'Next song: <title>' under the Next row, once the live song has at most its last cue or move ahead: when the last cue is next, and after it, whether the Next row then says 'End of track' or a later song's first cue. Mid-song and on the class's last song the focal card is unchanged. It is a visible label and text (no colour, no motion); playback, seeking, transport and the screen-reader cue announcements are unchanged. Not verified on a real device: the owner's glance at Cue-by-Cue at a song's last cue is the manual check named in #789. RF-239 holds the Next row naming a cue from a song past an unchoreographed next song.
